mutants.name: TOR 1: a partly overlapping span counts as a match
TOR 2: only the end is compared
TOR 3: only the start is compared
TOR 0 compares the start, not the end
TOR 1 lower bound is region 1's own base
NA4 0: the end is not checked
NA4 3: compares address bits [55:3]
NAPOT 2: the end is not checked
NAPOT 1: the start is not checked
NAPOT 0: mask one bit too small
NAPOT 3: size without the first zero bit
region 2 base shifted by one bit
region 3 treated as OFF
priority order reversed for read
mutants.old: wire rperm   = m0 ? r0 : m1 ? r1 : m2 ? r2 : r3;
mutants.new: wire rperm   = m3 ? r3 : m2 ? r2 : m1 ? r1 : r0;

mutants.name: priority order reversed for the lock bit
mutants.old: wire locked  = m0 ? l0 : m1 ? l1 : m2 ? l2 : l3;
mutants.new: wire locked  = m3 ? l3 : m2 ? l2 : m1 ? l1 : l0;

mutants.name: write permission read from the exec bit
mutants.old: wire wperm   = m0 ? w0 : m1 ? w1 : m2 ? w2 : w3;
mutants.new: wire wperm   = m0 ? x0 : m1 ? x1 : m2 ? x2 : x3;

mutants.name: exec permission read from the read bit
mutants.old: wire xperm   = m0 ? x0 : m1 ? x1 : m2 ? x2 : x3;
mutants.new: wire xperm   = m0 ? r0 : m1 ? r1 : m2 ? r2 : r3;
